map.丹佛发育筛查测验(DDST)，按年龄线筛查个人-社会、精细运动-适应性、语言、大: Denver Developmental Screening Test (DDST): screen four domains - personal-social, fine-motor-adaptive, language, gross-motor - by age lines
map.「丹佛发育筛查测验(DDST)，按年龄线筛查个人-社会、精细运动-适应性、语言、: The DDST developmental screening tool screens the four domains - personal-social, fine-motor-adaptive, language, gross-motor - by age lines, and outputs results based on the input parameters.
map.矫正胎龄 (周，早产儿填写): Corrected gestational age (weeks, for preterm infants)
map.各能区项目均通过年龄线左侧: All domain items pass on the left of the age line
map.≥1项完全在年龄线右侧失败/2项以上在年龄线区域失败: ≥1 item fails completely to the right of the age line / ≥2 items fail within the age-line zone
map.≥2项完全在年龄线右侧失败/1能区≥2项延迟: ≥2 items fail completely to the right of the age line / ≥2 delays in one domain
map.提示：DDST为筛查工具非诊断工具，适用于0-6岁儿童。年龄线左侧75%儿童能通: Note: DDST is a screening, not a diagnostic tool, for children 0-6 years. To the left of the age line, 75% of children pass = 'pass'; on the line = 'age-line item'; to the right = 'harder item'. Preterm infants are assessed by corrected age until age 2. A positive screen needs referral to diagnostic assessments such as the Gesell or Bayley scales. This tool is for screening reference only.
map.个人-社交/精细等 2 能区未通过→异常，2–3 周复查仍异常转诊。: Personal-social/fine-motor etc. 2 domains fail -> abnormal; re-check after 2-3 weeks, refer if still abnormal.
map.各能区通过≥80%→正常，定期体检随访。: Each domain ≥80% pass -> normal, regular check-up follow-up.
map.个人-社交、精细动作、语言、大运动；任 2 能区延迟为异常。: Personal-social, fine-motor, language, gross-motor; delay in any 2 domains is abnormal.
map.DDST 为筛查，异常需小儿神经/发育专科进一步评估。: DDST is screening; abnormalities need further pediatric neuro/developmental specialist evaluation.
map.关于「智力(DDST)发育筛查器」: About the DDST Developmental Screening Tool
map.丹佛发育筛查(DDST)工具，按年龄线评估个人-社会、精细运动、语言、大运动四大: The Denver Developmental Screening (DDST) tool assesses the four domains - personal-social, fine-motor, language, gross-motor - by age lines. A medical professional tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
